policy_name: Stremiium Enterprise Security & Least Privilege Baseline
zero_exposure_rules: Raw private keys, API secrets, and OAuth refresh tokens must NEVER appear in agent prompts, system context, or log output.
Credentials must be resolved server-side via encrypted key-vaults with ephemeral runtime session tokens.
Data categorized as POPIA Personal Identifiable Information (PII) must be masked before entering public model inference tiers.
human_in_the_loop_triggers: Smart contract mainnet deployments on Polygon or other chains.
Treasury asset transfers exceeding ZAR 50,000 equivalent.
Production database DROP, TRUNCATE, or schema migration operations.
Formal regulatory submissions to the FSCA, FIC, SARS, or National Gambling Board.
Creation or modification of executive security policies and root permissions.
